How I Met Your Mother Actor Nick Pasqual Found Guilty of Attempted Murder After Stabbing Ex-Girlfriend Multiple Times

  • May 12, 2026
  • Uncategorized
Embed from Getty Images
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:48
Instaread

Nick Pasqual spent two years denying he tried to kill his ex-girlfriend. A jury spent far less time deciding he did.

The 36-year-old actor, known for his appearances on How I Met Your Mother, was found guilty May 8 of attempted murder, first-degree residential burglary, rape, and injuring a spouse or partner following a jury trial in Los Angeles. He will be sentenced June 2 and faces a maximum of life in state prison.

Prosecutors alleged that in May 2024, Pasqual broke into the Shadow Hills home of Hollywood makeup artist Allie Shehorn — his estranged girlfriend — and stabbed her multiple times. After the attack, he fled and was captured at a border checkpoint in Texas.

Shehorn took the witness stand last week with visible scars on her arm and neck. She described the relationship’s final months in tearful detail, including a violent fight that preceded their breakup.

“I locked the door and he just started punching holes in that door and broke that open, and I just ran into the bathroom because I thought there’s another lock on that door,” she said on the stand.

In her restraining order request filed just days before the attack, Shehorn had accused Pasqual of rape and choking her in April 2024, and hitting her with a belt in January of that year. The restraining order was filed May 20. The attack came days later.

Pasqual had pleaded not guilty to all charges. His attorney has not responded to requests for comment following the verdict. Shehorn has not issued a public statement since the conviction.

Pasqual appeared in several television projects over the course of his career, with How I Met Your Mother being his most recognizable credit. His sentencing is scheduled for June 2 in Los Angeles.
